_doc: Machine-readable slice table for ASTRYX-PLAN.md. id = RSI item id. deps are slice ids that must be MERGED (see state/merged.log). size: M ~30 min/<=500 lines, L ~45 min/<=800 lines. `paths` are the claim footprint (specific files/dirs); `brief` is the seed the director expands after reading the code. Paths marked (verify) may need correcting against main. | executor: "cloud" marks a slice for an external (Cursor cloud) agent: the director writes state/cloud-briefs/<slug>.md + `lanes.py cloud-claim` instead of using a local lane; the merge lane treats the resulting PR like any other. Unlaunched cloud claims expire after 3h and the slice falls back to local lanes.
